info.name: CortexAI B2B API (Complete)
info.description: Postman collection for CortexAI API-first contract validation: health/runtime diagnostics, browser lifecycle diagnostics, display-safe billing plans/current subscription, effective entitlements, server-owned Stripe Checkout/Portal sessions and webhooks, catalog discovery, legacy and direct-to-S3 file upload/status/deletion, chat/compare (sync + streaming), durable CortexAI Work sessions/runs/events/approvals/artifacts/tool connections, unified-credit Cortex Analysis runs, BYOK, history, reporting/exports, optimize, and admin diagnostics. Cache-aware accounting preserves the existing credit economy, starts in shadow mode, and exposes cache/read/write audit fields plus informational savings. Fresh Tavily research settles as provider credits used x 5,000 Cortex credits after a 10,000-credit normal-search reservation; cached/reused research is not charged again. DATABASE_URL is required at API startup, and PostgreSQL startup fails early when required billing migrations are missing. Reverse-proxy handling defaults to ENABLE_PROXY_HEADERS=true and TRUSTED_PROXY_IPS=*. Session cookies auto-detect HTTPS for the Secure attribute and default to SESSION_MAX_AGE_SECONDS=604800; Cognito endpoint TLS verification defaults to COGNITO_SSL_VERIFY=true.

item.name: Identity
item.description: Session-cookie endpoints use SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE when explicitly configured, otherwise the effective HTTPS request scheme controls the Secure attribute. Cookies persist for SESSION_MAX_AGE_SECONDS (default 604800; 0 creates a browser-session cookie). Behind CloudFront or an ALB, keep ENABLE_PROXY_HEADERS=true, configure TRUSTED_PROXY_IPS for trusted upstreams, and use COGNITO_SSL_VERIFY=true outside controlled local troubleshooting.

request.description: Returns the server-resolved plan, lifecycle state, features, model access categories, server-owned file limits, current period, and unified AI-credit allowance. BILLING_ENABLED controls Stripe availability. When false, valid Cortex grants resolve Plus/Pro with plan.source=cortex_grant; other users resolve Free. Grant usage resets monthly from its UTC start, clipped at expiry. Grant management is operator CLI only.

item.name: CortexAI Work and Tools
item.description: Requires signed-session/Cognito identity, CORTEX_WORK_ENABLED=true, the 20260820 migration, and a Plus/Pro entitlement. Live runs additionally require configured Managed Agent resources. Work session history is chronological and keeps earlier prompts, outcomes, and deliverables visible after follow-up instructions.

request.description: Creates a durable Work session. The optional title is limited to 200 characters and normalized to a provider-safe single line by collapsing whitespace and removing Unicode control or format characters.

exec: pm.test('Work session response is explicit', function () { pm.expect([201, 403, 404, 503]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Returns every owned run in chronological order so a client can rebuild the complete Work transcript, including earlier outcomes and deliverables.

exec: pm.test('run history is chronological', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); const rows = pm.response.json(); for (let i = 1; i < rows.length; i += 1) { pm.expect(new Date(rows[i - 1].created_at).getTime()).to.be.at.most(new Date(rows[i].created_at).getTime()); } });
